items.title: 【工具自荐】AI Video Detector：面向可疑社交视频链接的一次性信号筛查工具
items.author: robot19960122-web
items.summary: 阮老师好，推荐一个我做的网页工具：AI Video Detector。 链接：AI Video Detector 它面向一个具体场景：用户在社交平台看到可疑视频时，希望先做一次低成本的初步筛查，再决定是否继续转发、查源或深入验证。 主要功能： 支持公共社交视频链接和本地上传。 生成 evidence report，包含 likelihood、confidence、source/media access、visual artifact、motion、compression、audiovideo consistency 等信号。 明确展示工具能访问到多少媒体证据，以及哪些信号受平台限制。 采用谨慎表述，不声称 100% 判断真假，也不替代人工核验。 为什么做：AI 视频和剪辑误导越来越常见，但普通用户往往缺少一个结构化的“先别急着转发”的检查步骤。这个工具希望提供一个 firstpass screening 入口，把可疑点和局限性整理出来。 如果适合周刊“工具/资源”栏目，欢迎收录；如果不适合也没关系。
items.content:

为什么做：AI 视频和剪辑误导越来越常见，但普通用户往往缺少一个结构化的“先别急着转发”的检查步骤。这个工具希望提供一个 first-pass screening 入口，把可疑点和局限性整理出来。

items.author: suruiran
items.summary: 额，你好。 链接： DBNova 演示视频 ： youtube 可以根据数据库结构生成Ts类型，然后再配合内置的 SQL generator 来和数据库交互。 对于SQL文件也是支持的，还有一些扩展： sql @param a / number / default=1; max=10 @param b / number / default=2; max=10 select ${a} + ${b} as sum; 当执行的时候，会弹出表单。这样就可以让SQL像函数一样被调用。 还有一些其他的特性，请阅读文档，并尝试。
items.content:
额，你好。

链接： [DBNova](https://dbnova.ruiransoft.com/)
演示视频 ： [youtube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sgwHwtp93MA)

可以根据数据库结构生成Ts类型，然后再配合内置的 [SQL generator](https://github.com/suruiran/aghsorm) 来和数据库交互。

对于SQL文件也是支持的，还有一些扩展：

```sql
-- @param a / number / default=1; max=10
-- @param b / number / default=2; max=10
select ${a} + ${b} as sum;
```

当执行的时候，会弹出表单。这样就可以让SQL像函数一样被调用。

还有一些其他的特性，请阅读文档，并尝试。

items.content: ### 项目名称 TheNextCV (thenextcv.com) ### 项目简介 一个专为求职者打造的简历排版工具，支持将 AI 生成的 Markdown 文本一键转化为排版精美、适合打印的 PDF 简历，解决“AI 简历内容好写，但格式难调”的痛点。 ### 项目地址 - 网站：https://thenextcv.com ### 核心功能与特点 现在大家找工作，普遍会用 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 针对不同岗位定制简历。AI 输出的基本都是 Markdown 格式，但直接复制到 Word 或市面上的简历工具里，格式往往会乱掉，调整页边距和字体非常痛苦。 TheNextCV 正是为了解决这个问题而生的： 1. **Markdown 直出 PDF**：直接粘贴 AI 撰写的 Markdown 文本，一键生成符合 HR 审美的专业简历样式。 2. **完美支持打印/导出**：针对 A4 纸张和打印场景进行了深度优化，自动处理分页断行，拒绝排版错位。 3. **极速定制与调整**：支持快速调整字体、间距、主题色等排版要素，5 秒钟即可完成一份针对特定岗位的简历定制。 4. **简洁无广告**：没有臃肿的社交功能，专注“输入文本 - 一键导出”的纯粹体验。 ### 为什么推荐它？ 在当前的求职环境下，针对不同岗位“一岗一策”地定制简历是刚需。AI 解决了内容的生产效率，而 TheNextCV 解决了最后的排版和交付效率。希望这个小工具能帮到正在找工作的朋友们。

items.author: ip2b
items.summary: 项目地址 类别 Rust 项目标题 一个目录的会话想复制到另一个目录继续用？不同电脑的会话没办法移动？claude和codex的会话不能通用？这个项目帮你解决 项目描述 memorph 是一个会话的管理项目，提供web版，tui版和桌面端，全平台支持，确保在任何的环境都可以正常使用
items.content: ### 项目地址 https://github.com/ip2a/memorph ### 类别 Rust ### 项目标题 一个目录的会话想复制到另一个目录继续用？不同电脑的会话没办法移动？claude和codex的会话不能通用？这个项目帮你解决 ### 项目描述 **memorph** 是一个会话的管理项目，提供web版，tui版和桌面端，全平台支持，确保在任何的环境都可以正常使用 [](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/48f64650-267a-4796-b1e4-f75846c9dc6a) 随着开发模式逐渐转向与 Agent 交互式协作，任何一个编程助手都难以独立解决所有问题。 开发中有时候会遇到，使用一个编程助手分析到了一定的程度之后，接下来的工作需要换一个编程助手去解决。 类似的问题还有一个目录的会话想复制到另一个目录继续用？不同电脑的会话没办法移动？claude和codex的会话不能通用？ 而除了项目产物之外，最宝贵的数据，其实是你的会话记录——其中蕴藏着大量我们尚未充分利用的关键上下文。 ### 快速体验 运行以下命令启动 Web 版本： ```bash npx memorph web ``` 快速启动一个端口，哪怕在linux服务器上也可以正常使用 切换成功之后可以直接进入 同时提供相同 UI 的 DMG 桌面版本（已发布）。 ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/68449a8e-b330-4136-903e-27f7154adbf5) 或使用以下命令体验 TUI 版本： ```bash npx memorph ``` ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0269e151-b473-493a-bc94-065b94e88794) ### 四种操作形式 - CLI - TUI - Web - 桌面端（DMG 安装包约 5MB，简单轻量） 其中，TUI 和 Web 版本最适合大多数用户快速使用，并且可在纯终端环境下运行；CLI 版本则更适合封装为 Skill，让 Agent 自主完成会话切换。 本项目将所有编程助手的会话数据统一为一个中间格式的会话数据，从而可以基于 **memorph** 实现共享会话，无感迁移一个会话在不同的编程助手上 附带会话清理功能，通过筛选时间和大小，快速清理或者备份已经无用的会话 ### 亮点 深入研究了每个coding agent的会话特点和标签，并做到和任意其中一家的agent切换 ### 示例代码 ```markdown ``` ### 截图或演示视频 _No response_

items.content:
### 项目地址

https://github.com/alexchan197611/ai_caption_video

### 类别

C

### 项目标题

一个本地运行的中文短视频大字报生成器，一段文本一键生成视频带配音

### 项目描述

# ai_caption_video：一个本地运行的中文短视频大字报生成器

大家好，我想自荐一个自己正在开发的开源项目：

项目地址：  
https://github.com/alexchan197611/ai_caption_video

`ai_caption_video` 是一个使用 Python 开发的中文短视频生成工具，目标是制作类似“字说”“卡点字幕”“知识博主大字报”风格的视频。

它适合把一段中文文案快速生成竖屏短视频，支持大字幕、关键词高亮、字幕动效、本地 TTS 配音和语音克隆。

## 主要功能

- 生成 9:16 竖屏短视频
- 大号粗体中文字幕
- 多行文案输入，每一行对应一个字幕片段
- 支持关键词标记和高亮
- 支持每行单独设置颜色
- 支持字幕切换动效
- 支持滚动队列字幕模板
- 支持手机比例实时预览
- 支持背景音乐
- 支持本地 TTS
  - Qwen3-TTS
  - OmniVoice
- 支持本地语音克隆
- 支持 Windows EXE 打包

## 项目预览

界面截图：

![GUI Preview](https://github.com/alexchan197611/ai_caption_video/blob/main/images/gui-main.png)

演示视频：

https://github.com/alexchan197611/ai_caption_video/blob/main/images/demo.mp4

## 技术栈

- Python
- Tkinter
- MoviePy
- Pillow
- FFmpeg
- Qwen3-TTS
- OmniVoice

## 开发初衷

我希望做一个本地优先、可开源、可二次开发的中文短视频工具。  
很多同类工具要么是闭源软件，要么依赖云端服务，要么不方便普通创作者自定义。

这个项目目前还在持续迭代，后续计划增加：

- 每一句单独配图
- 更多字幕模板
- 更丰富的转场动效
- 更完善的 TTS 模型接入
- 更方便的便携版打包方式

欢迎大家试用、提建议，也欢迎参与贡献。

### 亮点

## 主要功能

- 多行文案输入：每一行生成一个字幕片段
- 1080x1920 竖屏黑底视频
- 大号中文粗体字幕居中显示
- 9:16 phone-style live preview for the current line
- adjustable font size with real-time wrapping preview
- 选中文字标记重点，视频中显示黄色并带心跳动效
- per-line base color selection with keyword highlights preserved
- 每句可单独绑定背景图片，未配图时自动使用黑底
- 背景图片自动裁切为 9:16，并随机应用轻微推拉和平移运镜
- 随机字幕切换动画：缩小、滑出、竖起收起、倾斜缩小等
- rolling queue caption template: read text turns vertical, current text is enlarged, upcoming text waits below
- 可选背景音乐，自动裁剪到视频长度并降低音量
- 内置音乐库支持随机选曲，并让句间切换吸附到鼓点；连续生成时尽量避免重复曲目
- 可选 TTS：
  - Qwen3-TTS：支持预设人声、语音设计、语音克隆
  - OmniVoice：支持自动音色、语音设计、语音克隆和原生语速控制
- GUI 桌面界面
- PyInstaller 打包脚本

Bitcoinstream.live is a 24/7 market war room aggregating microsecond data across 15+ exchanges. 🎯 Whale Barriers: Separate Spot/Perp institutional walls. 💀 Liquidation HeatMap: Track leverage targets live. 🐋 Whale Radar: Monitor big trades & on-chain BTC/USDT flows. ⏰ Smart Alarms: Set multiple alerts revealing exact exchange triggers. 📸 Snapshots: Share charts instantly via unique URLs. 📻 Crypto Radio: 24/7

items.title: Lakshmi Stores UK
items.summary: Buy Passion Fruit Online
items.content: Lakshmi Stores UK is the Indian Online Grocery Store in Southampton, sells Fresh Fruits and Vegetables Online. Buy Fruits and Veggies Online in the UK

items.title: Level Up Fitness AI
items.summary: Stop guessing, start progressing.
items.content: Level Up Fitness is an AI-powered fitness tracker that combines workout logging, nutrition tracking, cardio, and recovery into one unified system. It uses gamified progression with XP, levels, and unlockable prestige themes to make fitness more engaging. AI analysis helps identify why progress is stalling by reviewing habits across training, diet, and recovery. Built for gym-goers and beginners who want clearer insights and structured progress instead of multiple separate apps.

items.title: Foglamp
items.summary: Ship AI agents you can actually see
items.content: The open source observability layer for AI agents built on the Vercel AI SDK. Costs, latency, tokens, distributed traces, evals, and alerts for every generateText / streamText call — in two lines.

items.title: Protein Pricer
items.summary: See what your protein actually costs
items.content: Stop doing mental math in grocery store. Scan any barcode, enter the price, and instantly see price per gram of protein, protein per dollar, and a clear value rating. No barcode? Pick from fresh proteins and enter the price per pound. A lot of stuff has "protein" slapped on the packaging but is terrible value per gram. This app shows you the real numbers. Community pricing database lets you see what others are paying at different stores. Currently free, no ads. iOS now, Android coming soon.

items.title: DiscountHub
items.summary: Coupons, promo codes and deals in one free app
items.content: DiscountHub helps shoppers find coupons, promo codes, discounts and online deals from different stores and marketplaces in one simple app. Instead of checking many websites, users can browse offers, open the original store page and save time when looking for better prices. Currently available on iOS, with Android coming soon.

items.title: Sweat & Legacy
items.summary: Making Productivity Fun and competitive
items.content: Sweat & Legacy is a competitive productivity workspace that combines task management, focus sessions, streaks, analytics, heatmaps, and leaderboards in one place. Stay consistent, track your progress, build better habits, and turn productivity into a rewarding experience. Instead of switching between multiple apps, manage your work, measure your performance, and challenge yourself to improve every day—all from a single workspace.

items.title: Alias Browser
items.summary: Tagline (45/60) One browser. Unlimited identities.
items.content: Alias Browser is an anti-detect browser built for managing multiple online identities. Unlike regular browser profiles, each Alias profile gets its own fingerprint, cookies, storage, proxy, VPN and DNS settings, making it appear as a separate device. It includes built-in proxy testing, per-profile ad blocking, a local REST API, an MCP server for AI automation, zero telemetry, optional encrypted sync, and support for Windows, macOS and Linux.

items.title: Bank Master
items.summary: Track your picks, parlays & bankroll with real stats
items.content: Most bettors don't really know their ROI. They remember the wins and forget the losses. Bank Master fixes that. Create multiple banks, log every pick and parlay, and see your actual stats, ROI, win rate, yield, and bankroll evolution over time. Built for serious bettors who want to improve their strategy with real data, not gut feeling. No ads. Free to try.

items.title: Stepapper
items.summary: AI-matched, flexible jobs for students
items.content: Connects university students with internships and entry-level jobs, enhancing career prospects while helping companies find motivated talent.

items.title: LeadEngine AI
items.summary: B2B AI LeadGen SaaS built with FastAPI & Next.js
items.content: Production-ready B2B AI LeadGen & Audit SaaS codebase asset. Stack: FastAPI, Next.js, Redis, Celery, Docker. Architecture: Multi-tenant with robust database isolation & dynamic White-Label branding engine (logos/colors). Integrations: 42 tested endpoints (OpenAI, SerpAPI, Stripe billing, PageSpeed). Founder shifting focus. The entire infrastructure is ready for secure private GitHub transfer via Escrow. DM for the live Loom video walkthrough and architecture details! 🚀

items.title: Bernt
items.summary: Less thinking, more cooking.
items.content: Bernt is an AI kitchen companion for iPhone. Tell it what you're in the mood for and it picks a recipe — or plans your whole week — tuned to your cooking skill, household size, budget, and diet. No endless menus, no scrolling. It decides, you cook.

items.title: WatchDrive
items.summary: Stay awake behind the wheel with your Apple Watch
items.content: WatchDrive is an Apple Watch app designed to help drivers stay alert on the road. Whether you’re commuting, driving long distances, or traveling late at night, WatchDrive provides timely reminders and notifications that encourage awareness of fatigue before it becomes dangerous. Simple, lightweight, and always with you on your wrist.

items.title: PHUNT
items.summary: Auto-generate Chinese promo videos for your Product Hunt
items.content: Reach 800M+ Chinese users with zero effort. PHUNT auto-generates polished 30s vertical promo videos (1080×1920) for any PH product — designed for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili. How it works: 🔍 Fetch product from PH API ✍️ AI generates Chinese copy 🎙️ Professional TTS voiceover 🎨 Stripe Aurora design + GSAP 🎬 One command → production video Open source. Free forever.

items.title: Linking Your AI
items.summary: Your Al Assistant: On your computer, with your notes.
items.content: Don't get locked into your AI tool. Instead, own the system your AI assistant runs on. Linking Your AI delivers a personal, private AI assistant that leverages your own notes and gets more useful the more you use it. Install it. Instantly get 23 working skills and 8 systems (automated daily briefs and much more). Easily customize and reshape them around your personal needs. Guided setup and a maker community help you get running fast.

items.title: ElevateStaffing.ai
items.summary: The bench-to-billing platform built for IT staffing
items.content: End-to-end SaaS for IT staffing firms — the full bench-to-billing lifecycle in one system: sourcing, matching, placement, onboarding, timesheets, and billing. Built from day one around H-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, and green-card workflows, not bolted on. Recruiting, immigration tracking, and invoicing share one candidate record. AI drafts outreach, matches, and resume rewrites for review — AI generates, your team decides. Enterprise-grade: tenant isolation, encryption, RBAC, full audit trail.

items.title: Simplance
items.summary: The all-in-one money workspace for freelancers
items.content: Most freelancers juggle a spreadsheet for expenses, one app for invoices, and a separate calculator at tax time. Nothing talks to each other. Simplance puts it in one workspace: send proposals and convert them to invoices in a click, track expenses by tax category, estimate federal, state, and self-employment taxes, forecast cash flow, and ask an AI advisor about your actual numbers. Built only for freelancers, so it isn't bloated for agencies. Free to start, no card required. US and UK.

items.title: Unreal Engine 5.8
items.summary: Build unreal games with AI agents
items.content: Unreal Engine 5.8 is the final major milestone of the UE5 lifecycle. It introduces experimental 3D Mesh Terrain to replace traditional heightfields, production-ready MegaLights for current-gen consoles, and a native MCP plugin for AI agent automation.
